title: Community alpha.1 upload completion, resource download and bounded semantics
objective: Lock Community alpha.1 from unimplemented draft with actual upload completion, author query, controlled download, explicit size/error/idempotency and fail-closed publication semantics before producer work.
in_scope: Community alpha.1 OpenAPI convergence, upload-completion/author-list/download additions
Semantic validation and examples; compatibility classification and version lock
Existing Core SDK generation and package gates unchanged
out_of_scope: Community business implementation or SDK operation exposure without producer evidence
F4 social/admin contracts or production moderation/provider/legal choice
contract_impact: prerelease convergence and additions; Community draft has no producer/consumer. Core alpha.7 and Skin alpha.1 byte unchanged.
acceptance_evidence: OpenAPI/schema/examples and alpha.1 semantic validator pass
Existing Core SDK format/lint/typecheck/generate-check/test/build/pack and real smoke pass
Clean completed record and local main ff-only integration
validation_results: ADR-0014 approves structural resource semantics; no social/moderator/production provider policies invented. Existing Core and Skin locks must remain byte-stable. Local-only delivery.
